decisions.reason: Reviewing chapter titles and subtitles does not change the independently defined styling of Mama's Hot Take content.
The source decision concerns textual chapter headings and does not alter image aspect ratio, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The dedication page content remains unaffected by the request to review chapter titles and subtitles.
The source decision does not change whether, where, or how chapter images are placed.
Copyright-page content and presentation are independent of chapter-title and subtitle formatting.
Reviewing chapter headings does not necessarily alter body-text paragraph spacing or page-density requirements.
The request to review chapter titles and subtitles does not change the editorial criteria or selections for chapter images.

The same message independently questions the first-page author-name hierarchy, which is already represented by an AMBIGUOUS Event; the chapter-heading modification does not itself change the title-page state.
The source requests formatting review of headings rather than changing the manuscript's prose-editing or punctuation-polish requirements.
Chapter-title and subtitle formatting within the manuscript does not necessarily change the separately defined paperback-cover design.
The formatting request does not change the requested guidance about publication readiness, front or back matter, or copyright.
The chapter-heading formatting decision does not alter KDP metadata entry, upload assistance, or process support.
